ui.design_rationale: The request adds an orders-wide revenue calculation to an ecommerce app, so a restrained blue finance-oriented data style fits without changing existing screens.

files.purpose: Add total_revenue(), summing payment transaction amounts and subtracting refund transaction amounts across every order.

verify.steps: Call the orders service total_revenue endpoint and confirm it returns the sum of all payment amounts minus all refund amounts across every order.

assumption: The existing seeded order and payment graph is the source of truth, so total_revenue should aggregate persisted Payment nodes across all orders without changing the UI.
